title: OVAL-Prompt: Open-Vocabulary Affordance Localization for Robot Manipulation through LLM Affordance-Grounding
summary: An open-vocabulary pipeline that combines visual part segmentation with language-model affordance grounding for manipulation without task-specific fine-tuning.

mechanisms.name: Open-vocabulary part-affordance prompting
mechanisms.description: Uses language reasoning to map an instruction to an object part, then grounds that part visually for manipulation.
mechanisms.limitations: LLM part selection can be semantically plausible yet physically wrong; manipulation demonstrations do not prove egocentric navigation completion or safe use.
